astral_dice.guide.category.cards.desc: Cards come in battle cards and effect cards: battle cards slot into the dice card bar and occupy cost slots, granting points during the Blessing; effect cards have their own play count and cooldown.
Attack cards: consume one use on the attack that triggers the Dice Blessing and take effect, granting attack points in dice battles.
astral_dice.guide.category.cards_defense: Defense cards: consume one use when you are hit and defend in a PvP dice battle, granting defense points.
Effect cards: grant various bonuses on use. Each play consumes one play count; once the play count is used up, the cards enter cooldown, and the play count is restored when the cooldown ends.; the play count is capped at §e9§7 per round.
astral_dice.guide.category.chips.desc: Chips are passive accessories granting attack, defense, speed, health and resource bonuses.
Chips tied to your Charge stacks: build Charge by moving, teleporting, killing and triggering the Dice Blessing, then convert it into attack, movement speed or skill-cooldown resets.
astral_dice.guide.category.chips_healing: Chips tied to your healing state: they keep your health safe and grant offensive bonuses while your HP is plentiful.
astral_dice.guide.category.chips_mark.de: Chips tied to applying the Mark status, providing steady bonuses for focus-fire playstyles.
astral_dice.guide.category.chips_other.d: Chips that grant various other passives.
astral_dice.guide.category.chips_starlig: Chips tied to your Starlight resource, handy for earning Star Coin profit.
astral_dice.guide.category.dice.desc: The dice is the core equipment: while equipped, melee attacks apply the Dice Blessing to you; card slot count is determined by the die's star level, and chip slot count by the die's tier and star level. Spend Star Coins on an anvil to star-up your dice and unlock more slots.
astral_dice.guide.category.getting_start: An accessory mod based on the Curios API. Equip dice, signs, chips and cards to gain buffs and combat abilities, and even pull off combo plays with your teammates.
astral_dice.guide.category.signs.desc: Signs grant character-flavored active and passive skills.
astral_dice.guide.entry.amethyst_dice.1: Amethyst die. Same tier as the Diamond Die and upgradeable from it; your ranged/magic attacks also roll the combat die (1-6) and add its roll as damage — without triggering a Dice Blessing.
astral_dice.guide.entry.atm_chip.1: Gain 1 Starlight on equip; converting Starlight to Star Coins yields 40%% more (rounded down; under the floor-1 policy the bonus is at least 1).
astral_dice.guide.entry.attack_card_char: Charge: fixed +5 attack power during the Dice Blessing; returns Full Power when the blessing ends.
astral_dice.guide.entry.attack_card_epic: Attack Card (XL): grants 1~10 attack power in dice battles (max of 2 rolls).
astral_dice.guide.entry.attack_card_full: Full Power: +6 attack power, and this strike's final attack power is +50%%.
astral_dice.guide.entry.attack_card_larg: Attack Card (Large): grants 1~6 attack power in dice battles (max of 2 rolls).
astral_dice.guide.entry.attack_card_medi: Attack Card (Medium): grants 1~3 attack power in dice battles (max of 2 rolls).
astral_dice.guide.entry.attack_card_meit: Meito: grants 1~20 attack in dice battles (max of 2 rolls).
astral_dice.guide.entry.attack_card_shad: Shadow Strike: fixed +3 attack power, and applies Darkness (0:03) to the target.
astral_dice.guide.entry.bank_card_high_c: Grants 7 base Starlight layers while equipped.
astral_dice.guide.entry.bank_card_low_ch: Grants 4 base Starlight layers while equipped.
astral_dice.guide.entry.bank_card_unlimi: Gain 3 Starlight on equip; after each Dice Blessing ends, you and friendly players gain 3 Star Coins (team members if you are in a team; all online players if you are not in any team).
astral_dice.guide.entry.battle_dice.1: With a dice equipped, melee attacks apply the Dice Blessing to you; attacks made under the Blessing enter an attack-versus-defense dice battle. The attacker's roll and card bonuses count toward attack; the defender rolls a defense dice toward defense, and final damage = attack − defense (minimum 1).
astral_dice.guide.entry.battle_dice.2: Monsters and players share the same defense formula: defense = 2 + armor÷2 + 1.4×toughness + defense dice + bonuses (1 defense = 2 armor); players roll their defense dice only during a Blessing.
astral_dice.guide.entry.battle_dice.3: Upgrade a die on the anvil with Star Coins to raise its star level for stronger blessings and more card slots (0★=4, 1★=6, 2★=8, 3★=12, half attack/half defense); the base → golden → diamond → netherite chain unlocks more chip slots (card slots follow the star level only, identical across tiers at the same star; any die of the same tier can be used as the upgrade base).
astral_dice.guide.entry.battle_dice.name: Battle Dice Rolls
astral_dice.guide.entry.bonnie_sign.1: Active - Covert Operation: use the target selector on a hostile mob or non-teammate player within §e16§7 blocks; confirming applies Hidden Investigation. If the target is marked, gain Star Coins equal to §e×2§7 the Mark layers. The selection session lasts §930 s§7; cancelling or timing out spends no cooldown.
astral_dice.guide.entry.bonnie_sign.2: Passive Skill - Key Clue: +3 attack against marked targets; killing a marked hostile with at least 20 HP grants a random battle card; killing an Undercover Investigation target triggers the Investigation event.
astral_dice.guide.entry.bonnie_sign.3: Investigation event (4 stages): I — you and the applier gain Invisibility (0:15); II — Invisibility + +2 vs non-boss hostiles (0:20); III — Invisibility + +(2+mark layers) vs non-boss hostiles (0:30); Truth revealed — you, the applier and your team (all players if you are not in a team) gain Invisibility, +(2+marks) vs non-boss and +(2+marks×2) vs bosses (1:00). While hidden during an Investigation stage, you cannot be targeted by mobs.
astral_dice.guide.entry.buffer_shield_ch: When damaged, gain 2 healing layers and 3 Star Coins, once per 15 seconds.
astral_dice.guide.entry.candy_chip.1: Each effect card used grants +1 Healing layer and restores 1 health; at full health, this round's card slots +1 (at most once per round).
astral_dice.guide.entry.cursed_sword_chi: While equipped you always suffer the Blue Curse: Armor -20%%, Armor Toughness -100%%.
During a Dice Blessing, killing a hostile with at least 20 HP grants +1 attack (at most 1 per blessing), up to +16; removing the chip clears all bonuses and the Blue Curse.
Enigmatic Legacy+ link: while equipped, the Scroll of a Thousand Curses' curse count +1.
astral_dice.guide.entry.cutter_blade_chi: At 60%% health or above, Attack Power +4, plus your current healing layers.
astral_dice.guide.entry.cutter_chip.1: At 60%% health or above, Attack Power +2, plus your current healing layers.
astral_dice.guide.entry.defense_card_epi: Defense Card (XL): grants 1~10 defense power in dice battles (max of 2 rolls).
astral_dice.guide.entry.defense_card_lar: Defense Card (Large): grants 1~6 defense power in dice battles (max of 2 rolls).
astral_dice.guide.entry.defense_card_med: Defense Card (Medium): grants 1~3 defense power in dice battles (max of 2 rolls).
astral_dice.guide.entry.diamond_dice.1: Diamond die. A higher tier that unlocks more chip slots; card slots follow the star level only (identical across tiers at the same star).
astral_dice.guide.entry.emerald_dice.1: Emerald die. Same tier as the diamond die and upgradeable from it; while equipped, villager trades use Star Coins instead of Emeralds with a 20%% discount.
astral_dice.guide.entry.obsidian_dice.1: Obsidian die. Same tier as the diamond die and upgradeable from it; while equipped you gain 3 base defense and take 70%% less fire damage.
astral_dice.guide.entry.weird_dice.1: Weird die. Same tier as the diamond die and upgradeable from it; sign active-skill cooldowns are halved, but your combat die is more likely to roll low (1-3).
astral_dice.guide.entry.crimson_dice.1: Crimson die. Same tier as the Netherite Die and upgradeable from it; your combat die is more likely to roll high (4-6), but rolling a 1 immediately deals 6 damage to you.
astral_dice.guide.entry.ender_dice.1: Ender die. Same tier as the Netherite Die and upgradeable from it; lethal damage triggers one totem-of-undying effect (followed by a 5:00 cooldown) and teleports you to safe ground within 16 blocks (no teleport while in water; a vanilla Totem of Undying trigger also teleports you), but damage taken in rain/underwater is increased by 40%%.
astral_dice.guide.entry.glass_dice.1: Glass die. Same tier as the Golden Die and upgradeable from it; your combat cards always roll their maximum, but dying destroys this die and all of its equipped cards.
astral_dice.guide.entry.nether_star_dice: Nether Star die. A new exotic T4 tier, upgradeable from any T3 die (4 Nether Stars in a cross around it); card slots and cost points are always at their maximum (12 slots / cost cap 6 each side), equippable chip count +1 (0★4/1★5/2★6/3★7); each star level grants +2 attack and +2 defense.
Netherrack die. Same tier as the Golden Die and upgradeable from it; mining ores in the Nether has a 30%% chance to drop a Star Coin and 5%% to drop a Star Plate, and piglins stay neutral to you.
astral_dice.guide.entry.dice.1: The base die. While equipped, melee attacks trigger the Dice Blessing (gain it on attack, activate dice combat while blessed, press the key to open the card inventory).
astral_dice.guide.entry.eagle_scope_chip: During a Dice Blessing, hitting a target applies 1 Mark layer; this combat, gain +2 attack per Mark layer on the target.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_bers: Berserk: +3 attack per stack and +1 damage taken per stack (max 3 stacks) for 3:00 (re-use adds a stack and refreshes the duration). Holding this card in your main hand opens the target selector automatically (pick a player within 16 blocks, no countdown); on confirm the target gains or stacks Berserk. Right-click to use it on yourself; putting the card away closes the selector and consumes nothing (no longer usable on other mobs).
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_choc: Chocolate Cake: restores 20%% of max HP.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_dire: Directional Blast: ranged/magic damage +5, dealing the same damage (including the effect-card damage bonus) to other targets within 6 blocks of the target, for 1:00.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_expr: Express Delivery: holding this card in your main hand opens the target selector automatically (pick a player within 16 blocks, no countdown); on confirm the target gains Speed II (1:00). Right-click to use it on yourself; putting the card away closes the selector and consumes nothing.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_fate: Fate's Guide (exclusive, usable only by its owner):
Play count +1; instantly halve the current max active-skill cooldown countdown.
Deal 20%% more damage to targets with a Weak Mark for 5:00.
Saturation from all food is doubled for 5:00.
Enigmatic Legacy+ link: while wearing the Cursed Ring, correct Curse 1 — incoming doubled damage reduced by 50%% for 5:00.
Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks link: spell mana costs halved for 5:00.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_figh: Fight Poison with Poison: gain Poison (0:08), then remove up to 3 vanilla negative effects and gain Regeneration II (0:30) (hidden icon).
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_king: King Power: take 8 damage, gain +5 attack per stack (max 3 stacks) for 3:00 (re-use adds a stack and refreshes the duration).
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_livi: Living Page (exclusive, usable only by its owner):

Holding this card in your main hand opens the target selector automatically (pick a hostile target within 16 blocks, no countdown); on confirm the page flies at the target at high speed and always hits (blocks do not stop it), deals 2 + the number of Living Pages the Investigator has used as spell damage (affected by all spell-damage bonuses) and applies 1 Mark layer. Putting the card away closes the selector and consumes nothing.

While wearing the Investigator sign, each Living Page used permanently increases its damage by +1; only when the target already had 3+ Mark layers before the hit does this card cycle grant +1 card slot (hard cap of 9 per round).
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_luxu: Luxury Feast: holding this card in your main hand opens the target selector automatically (pick a player within 16 blocks, no countdown); on confirm it heals the target and friendly players within 6 blocks (teammates only when you are on a team; all players when you are not) for 30%% of your max HP. Right-click to use it on yourself; putting the card away closes the selector and consumes nothing.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_unwa: Unwavering: armor +8 per stack (equal to +4 defense in dice battles), up to 3 stacks, and Resistance II for 3:00.
astral_dice.guide.entry.effect_card_you_: You Have, I Have: holding this card in your main hand opens the target selector automatically (pick another player within 16 blocks, no countdown; you cannot target yourself); on confirm you and the target each gain a random card. Putting the card away closes the selector and consumes nothing.
astral_dice.guide.entry.eight_sided_dice: When a Dice Blessing triggers, roll and accumulate; every 8 total points grant +1 Starlight (capped); rolling exactly 8 grants 8 Star Coins.
astral_dice.guide.entry.fanny_sign.1: Active Skill - Trouble Maker: immediately trigger one random event: gain Regeneration (0:30); gain Strength (0:30); gain an Attack Card (XL); gain a random effect card (excl. exclusive) + 3 Star Coins; gain Nourishment (2:00) (Farmer's Delight only) and Saturation (0:30); gain Speed (0:30).
astral_dice.guide.entry.fanny_sign.2: (continued) suffer Instant Damage; gain Poison (0:15); gain Hunger (0:30) and Nausea (0:07); gain Wither (0:07) and Darkness (0:05); gain Weakness (0:15) and Mining Fatigue (0:30).
astral_dice.guide.entry.fanny_sign.3: Passive Skill - Spot the Highlight: after you trigger an event, gain 3 Star Coins.
astral_dice.guide.entry.fen_sign.1: Active Skill - Channel Qi: for 1:00, attack +3; with Recharged Energy, heal 6 HP and gain Speed (1:00).
astral_dice.guide.entry.fen_sign.2: Passive Skill - Recharged Energy: with Recharged Energy, attack/defense +2; no Blessing triggered within 1:00 → Recharged Energy +1; triggering a Blessing → -1; triggering a Blessing at 5 layers → consume 2 and immediately deal 88%% of this attack's damage (minimum 5) as true damage to hostiles within 6 blocks of the target; using a healing effect card → +1.
Attacking a single hostile target grants +1 Starlight; every 4 layers of Starlight grant Attack Power +1.
astral_dice.guide.entry.friendship_badge: Friendship Badge: when you apply any healing effect to a friendly player, both of you gain 2 healing layers.
astral_dice.guide.entry.golden_dice.1: Golden die. A higher tier than the base die that unlocks more chip slots; card slots follow the star level only (identical across tiers at the same star).
astral_dice.guide.entry.golden_star_plat: A golden star plate for high-tier crafting; found in loot chests.
astral_dice.guide.entry.haiqing_sign.1: Active - Weakness Mark: use the target selector on a hostile mob or non-teammate player within §e16§7 blocks; confirming applies §9Weakness Mark (5:00)§7: damage taken §e+10%%§7 and gains Weakness. The selection session lasts §930 s§7; cancelling or timing out spends no cooldown.
astral_dice.guide.entry.haiqing_sign.2: Passive Skill - Lucky Star: a roll of 6 during the Dice Blessing immediately grants 6 Star Coins; when a Weak Marked target is killed, the Astrologer gains 3 Star Coins; if the killer is a player, that player gains a Fate's Guide.
astral_dice.guide.entry.hand_fan_big_chi: After using an active skill: gain a random effect card (excl. exclusive) and apply 1 Mark layer to all hostiles within range (for target-waiting signs this only triggers after the target is confirmed).
astral_dice.guide.entry.hand_fan_small_c: After using an active skill: apply 1 Mark layer to all hostiles within 16 blocks of you (for target-waiting signs this only triggers after the target is confirmed).
astral_dice.guide.entry.integration.2: Bountiful: bounty decrees can reward the mod's dice, star coins, star plates, cards, chips and signs (pure data-driven).
bountiful.decree.astral.name: Astral Bounties
astral_dice.guide.entry.integration.3: Enigmatic Legacy+: Fate's Guide corrects the Cursed Ring's curses; the Guardian sign corrects Curse 4 during Burst; the Cursed Sword tugs at the Scroll of a Thousand Curses.
astral_dice.guide.entry.integration.name: Mod Integration
astral_dice.guide.entry.jasmine_sign.1: Active Skill - Energy Overload: for 2:00, movement speed +20%% and armor -30%%, plus one random effect: Resistance (2:00) or Strength (2:00).
astral_dice.guide.entry.jasmine_sign.2: Passive Skill - Motion Charge: every 300 meters moved, alternately gain +1 attack and +1 defense (each capped); using an Express Delivery card immediately reduces the active skill's max cooldown by 50%%.
astral_dice.guide.entry.komachi_sign.1: Active - Ninja Combo: this round's card slots +1.
astral_dice.guide.entry.komachi_sign.2: Passive - Duplicator: every 3 effect cards used: copy the last card used to your inventory; your active skill cooldown is reduced by 30%%; damage effect card bonus +1.
astral_dice.guide.entry.lulu_sign.1: Active Skill - Healing Slime: pick any player (or use it on yourself); the target gains 3 healing layers and instant healing, and everything is centred on them: players/pets/rideables within range get instant healing, hostiles within range get Slowness (1:00).
astral_dice.guide.entry.lulu_sign.2: Passive Skill - Cell Division: when damaged, gain 1 healing layer and reduce the active skill's cooldown by 10 seconds.
astral_dice.guide.entry.magic_quiver_chi: If you use an effect card or hit with a Living Page and deal ranged or magic damage to a marked target: apply 1 Mark layer and return the first effect card used. Triggers at most once every 30 seconds.
Every 3 effect cards used: copy the last card used and return it to your inventory.
astral_dice.guide.entry.marker_sprayer_c: After dealing ranged or magic damage to a target, apply 1 Mark layer.
astral_dice.guide.entry.medkit_complete_: On Dice Blessing trigger, gain 3 healing layers.
astral_dice.guide.entry.medkit_emergency: On Dice Blessing trigger, gain 1 healing layer.
astral_dice.guide.entry.mimi_sign.1: Active Skill - Restock: recycle all cards in your inventory (including exclusive cards) and receive (recycled count +1) random cards (exclusive cards excluded).
astral_dice.guide.entry.mimi_sign.2: Passive Skill - Recycle: when you gain a battle card through crafting or your active skill's returns, gain 1 Star Coin; while equipped, chip slots +1; every 25 battle cards returned by your active skill grants a random chip.
astral_dice.guide.entry.misaki_sign.1: Active Skill - Sakura Sky Slash: for 2:00, attack +4; dice value increased by your equipped dice's star level (1★+1, 2★+2, 3★+3); Meito damage floor increased by star level (1★+2, 2★+3, 3★+5). If Sword Qi reaches 3 layers, consume 2 to exchange for a Meito.
astral_dice.guide.entry.misaki_sign.2: Passive Skill - Sword Qi: gain 1 layer when a Dice Blessing triggers (max 3); each layer grants +1 attack, with an extra +2 at 3 layers; the Meito card's cost is reduced to 3.
astral_dice.guide.entry.misaki_sign.3: Enigmatic Legacy+ link: while wearing the Cursed Ring during Burst, correct Curse 4 — always deal full damage.
astral_dice.guide.entry.nancy_lu_sign.1: Active Skill - Remote Intrusion: enter full invisibility instantly (up to 30 seconds). Attacking a hostile mob or player immediately removes invisibility, consumes one random battle card from your main inventory, and grants attack equal to that card's cost ×2 (minimum +2) for 2:00 (a guaranteed +2 still applies when no battle card is available in your main inventory).
astral_dice.guide.entry.nancy_lu_sign.2: Passive Skill - Network Firewall: immune to Ender Pearl teleport damage. After a Dice Blessing ends, if there are no hostiles within 6 blocks, gain +3 attack and a random battle card; otherwise gain +3 defense.
astral_dice.guide.entry.moses_sign.1: Active Skill - Weak Counter: use the target selector to pick a **normal hostile** within §e16§7 blocks and apply Broken (2:00). The selection session lasts §930 seconds§7; cancelling, timing out, or a target that already has Broken consumes no cooldown.
astral_dice.guide.entry.moses_sign.2: Passive Skill - Precision: the active cooldown is 120s while equipped; gain 1 Weakness Insight (max 4) after dodging, counterattacking, or attacking a Broken target. Each layer: attack/defense +1, minimum dice roll +1; one layer is removed when a Dice Blessing ends.
astral_dice.guide.entry.moses_sign.3: Broken effect: the target's dice can only be 0 while fighting the Gunsmith, and it is dodged by the Gunsmith; dodging triggers an automatic counterattack that includes Weakness Insight layers.
astral_dice.guide.entry.netherite_dice.1: Netherite die. The highest tier, unlocking the most chip slots; card slots follow the star level only (identical across tiers at the same star).
Effect card play count +1; ranged/magic damage to the target + the target's Mark layers.
astral_dice.guide.entry.padman_sign.1: Active - Really Angry: this attack/defense roll takes the maximum value.
astral_dice.guide.entry.padman_sign.2: Passive - No Opinion: your base attack/defense roll shifts over time (-2 to 4); during Dice Blessing, rolling 6 ignores the target's Defense (including armor); rolling 1 makes your next roll 6.
astral_dice.guide.entry.papara_sign.1: Active Skill - Take a Bite: for 3:00, attacking heals half of the combat damage dealt; taking damage heals half of the damage received; every health-conditioned effect counts as satisfied while the active skill is active.
astral_dice.guide.entry.papara_sign.2: Passive Skill - Cuteness Is Justice: at 50%% health or below, attack/defense +3.
astral_dice.guide.entry.parunan_sign.1: Active - Cash Out: convert Starlight into Star Coins at 2:1 and randomly gain one of: Saturation (0:30), Luck (5:00), Hero of the Village (15:00).
astral_dice.guide.entry.parunan_sign.2: Passive Skill - Legendary Merchant: gain +1 Starlight from time to time (capped); triggering a Dice Blessing grants Starlight equal to the first roll ×2.
astral_dice.guide.entry.piercing_gun_chi: Ranged/magic damage to the target gains bonus damage equal to the target's defense points.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.1: Four playstyles, each built around its own resource and mechanics:
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.2: Starlight: chips like the Flashlight, Eight-Sided Dice, ATM, Bank Cards and the Star Coin Hammer generate and spend it; the Merchant and Kanban Musume signs tie in.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.3: Healing: healing layers form a single pool provided by Medkits, the Slime sign and the Buffer Shield; triggering a Blessing heals you for healing layers × 2.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.4: Marks: build around mark stacks, combined with chips like the Magic Quiver for heavy spell damage.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.5: Charge: a player-level stack resource (max 20), built up by moving, teleporting, killing and triggering the Dice Blessing (Energy Recycler, Warp Engine, Electric Sword, Perpetual Motion). While you have any Charge, sign active cooldowns are capped at 160 seconds and effect-card cooldowns at 20 seconds (the base value is capped, and other reductions such as the Weird Dice still apply); stacks also convert into attack and movement speed, or the Current Core can spend them to instantly finish a sign's active cooldown.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.6: Beyond the four playstyles, general chips such as Boxing Gloves, Speed Skates and Sandwiches belong to none of them and directly buff your stats.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.7: Coordinate with teammates to pull off combos.
astral_dice.guide.entry.playstyles.name: Playstyles
astral_dice.guide.entry.revenge_halberd_: While under any of these effects, attack +6: Weakness, Slowness, Mining Fatigue, Blindness, Darkness, Wind Charged, Weaving, Oozing, Infested, Blue Curse.
While under any of these effects, defense +6: Hunger, Nausea, Poison, Wither, Raid Omen, Trial Omen, Marked.
Does not stack; the bonus vanishes the moment all matching effects are gone.
astral_dice.guide.entry.rin_sign.1: Active - Living Page: gain a Living Page.
astral_dice.guide.entry.rin_sign.2: Passive - Investigation Findings: when you trigger or are affected by an event, gain a Living Page (wearers within 32 blocks or in your team); using a Living Page permanently increases its damage by +1.
astral_dice.guide.entry.sandwich_high_ch: Max health +8; while max HP exceeds 20, gain +1 attack per 4 extra HP.
astral_dice.guide.entry.adrenaline_high_: Adrenaline (High-Grade): at 50%% health or below, attack/defense +8 (counts as satisfied while the Vampire sign's Drain is active).
While the bonus is active, being attacked by a hostile grants a 20%% chance to dodge a single attack.
astral_dice.guide.entry.adrenaline_low_c: Adrenaline (Common): at 50%% health or below, attack/defense +3 (counts as satisfied while the Vampire sign's Drain is active).
astral_dice.guide.entry.satellite_chip.1: If you hold fewer than 6 Orbital Strikes, gain one every 1:00.
astral_dice.guide.entry.satellite_chip.2: After using an Orbital Strike, this round's play count +1, once per 1:00.
astral_dice.guide.entry.satellite_chip.3: While an Orbital Strike is active, killing a hostile with ranged or magic damage grants a random effect card.
astral_dice.guide.entry.scope_chip.1: Attack +2; during a Dice Blessing, hitting a target applies 1 Mark layer.
Dice Blessing: triggered by melee attacks while a dice is equipped; attack and defense clash during it, and its duration cannot be overwritten by the dice effect until it ends.
Marks: scopes, ninja stars, hand fans and more stack marks on targets; chips like the Magic Quiver resolve around marks.
Effect card states: Berserk, King Power, Unwavering and more; some are hidden-icon effects (e.g. Regeneration II from Fight Poison with Poison).
Charge: using the Charge card returns Full Power when the blessing ends.
Effect pending: while an effect is still active, a new round cannot start even if the cooldown has reset.
astral_dice.guide.entry.spell_damage.1: Spell damage comes from the damage effect cards: Monster Laser, Monster Brick, Orbital Strike, Directional Blast and the Living Page.
astral_dice.guide.entry.spell_damage.2: Magic damage is affected by damage bonuses, e.g. the Ninja sign's "Damage Effect Card Bonus" passive grants +1 per 3 effect cards used.
astral_dice.guide.entry.spell_damage.3: The Magic Quiver applies 1 Mark layer and returns the first effect card used when you deal spell damage to a marked target.
astral_dice.guide.entry.star_coin.1: The mod's base currency, widely used in recipes and dice upgrading.
astral_dice.guide.entry.star_coin_bag.1: A pouch of 9 Star Coins; open it to retrieve them.
astral_dice.guide.entry.star_coin_hammer: Gain 5 Starlight on equip; if you hold more than 20 Star Coins, each Dice Blessing consumes 6 Star Coins and grants 30%% of your held Star Coins as attack (a Star Coin Bag counts as 9; when loose coins are short it breaks open one bag, takes only the coins needed and leaves the rest in your inventory, and consumes nothing if they cannot be stored safely).
astral_dice.guide.entry.star_plate.1: A plate of solidified starlight for higher crafts. It appears in no recipe itself.
astral_dice.guide.entry.regeneration_rea: Crafting material. A reagent brimming with the power of rebirth, the base ingredient for Healing-related crafting.
Crafting material. A wire that stores and transfers energy, the base ingredient for Charge-related crafting.
astral_dice.guide.entry.star_coin_dust.1: Crafting material. An alloy material made from Star Coins, usable in economy-related crafting.
astral_dice.guide.entry.mark_paint.1: Crafting material. Paint used to mark targets, the base ingredient for Mark-related crafting.

astral_dice.guide.entry.current_core_chi: On using the active skill: gain 1 charge. Pressing the active skill key while it is on cooldown spends charge in proportion to the remaining cooldown and instantly finishes it (no effect without enough charge); tiers are remaining cooldown ÷ 180 s split into 6 steps (1 minimum, 6 maximum).

astral_dice.guide.entry.smart_watch_chip: While you hold fewer than 6 cards, each hostile kill grants a random card.
astral_dice.guide.entry.airbag_chip.1: When taking fatal damage, consume 6 charge to negate the damage (cooldown 1:00). This saving effect takes priority over the Totem of Undying and the Ender Die; lethal damage that bypasses invulnerability is also negated (e.g. the /kill command).
astral_dice.guide.entry.electric_glove_c: On using an effect card: charge +1. With 4+ charge, using a damage effect card spends 4 charge so this cycle's ranged/magic damage also hits other targets within 3 blocks.
astral_dice.guide.entry.primordial_core_: Each charge spent grants 1 Empowerment layer (max 10). Each layer grants Attack Power +1 and Defense +1, and you lose 1 layer every 0:30.
astral_dice.guide.entry.railgun_chip.1: With at least 6 charge, Attack Power +5. On attacking a hostile target, after 1 second call down lightning on hostile targets within 3 blocks of the target, dealing "5 + 50%% of the triggering hit's damage" (minimum 5), then enter a 1:00 cooldown. Lightning is a separate true-damage source: it does not merge into the triggering hit and does not trigger Dice Blessing.
astral_dice.guide.entry.whetstone_chip.1: At 50%% health or below, Attack Power +4 and damage taken -2; while health is above 1, a single hit can at most reduce your health to 1.
astral_dice.guide.entry.warp_engine_chip: On teleport, charge +2 and gain Speed (0:10). Counted warps: ender pearl, the Ender Die's safe warp after the death totem, dimension portals, and Waystones (requires Waystones). Portals and Waystones share a 5:00 cooldown; ender pearl and Ender Die warps have no cooldown.
